context: Mei and Ren recount a surprising reunion.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (再び/なんだか/びっくり/無駄/いきなり) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昔の友達に、再び会えたの!
lines.en: I got to meet an old friend again!
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いきなり、街で会ったの?
lines.en: Did you meet suddenly in town?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、いきなりで、びっくりしたの。
lines.en: Yeah, it was sudden, and I was surprised.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なんだか、運命みたいだね。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 連絡先を、無くしてたのに会えたの。
lines.en: I'd lost the contact, yet we met.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 探す手間が、無駄にならなくて良かったね。
lines.en: Good that the effort to find them wasn't wasted.
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 再び、よく集まろうって話したの。
lines.en: We agreed to gather often again.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なんだか、嬉しい一日だったね。
lines.en: Somehow, it was a happy day.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
